wikipediaBodyRead.title: Ithobaal I
wikipediaBodyRead.locator: 「Relation to Ahab of Israel」L142–146および注1 L165。
wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: L146 relates Ithobaal’s daughter Jezebel to 1 Kings 16:31 and says the text labels him king of the Sidonians; note L165 gives the Hebrew form Ethbaal. The article heading is Ithobaal I, so relation-only is appropriate.
